[EVENT] User has been wearing Levi's jeans almost daily for a month.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant congratulated the user on their new dress shirt and tuxedo combo.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided tips for caring for Levi's jeans, including:  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 1. Wash them sparingly (every 10-15 wearings).  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 2. Use cold water only for washing.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 3. Avoid harsh detergents.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 4. Turn jeans inside out before washing.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 5. Air dry or tumble dry on low.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 6. Don't over-dry.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 7. Don't iron too much.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 8. Store them properly (folded or hung).  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 9. Consider freezing them to kill bacteria and odors.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 10. Get them hemmed or repaired if needed.
